metadata.cell_type: Primary human CD4+ T cell (Rest arm)
metadata.cell_line: Primary CD4+ T cells, 4 donors (GSE314342, Rest condition: expanded, then rested without CD3/CD28 re-stimulation)
metadata.description: Budget-aware protected gene list for the GSE314342 Rest arm. Genes listed here are force-included in SPORE HVG selection regardless of variance. Unlike the K562, RPE1 and h1-hESC lists, the tiers here are nested GENE BUDGETS: tier 1 is the protected core of the 400-gene micro panels, tiers 1-2 of the 1,000-gene panels, tiers 1-3 of the 5,000-gene production panel. SPORE itself loads all tiers (tier order = rescue order); the micro-panel builder reads panel_budget below.

tier_definitions.1: Micro-400 core (77 genes, 19% of a 400-gene panel). T-cell master regulators, TCR/activation hubs and core druggable immunology nodes. Every gene is perturbed in the Rest arm with >=200 single-target cells, so each can act as a regulator and as held-out interventional truth.
tier_definitions.2: Mid-1,000 extension (113 genes; tiers 1-2 = 190 genes, 19% of a 1,000-gene panel). Extended helper programs, checkpoints and cytokine readouts, TCR signal propagation, core chromatin, plus node-only genes with weak perturbation support.
tier_definitions.3: Full-5,000 extension (178 genes; tiers 1-3 = 368 genes, 7.4% of a 5,000-gene panel). Tahoe drug-target menu, quiescence, metabolism/survival and extended chromatin context.

metadata.selection_criterion: A gene is protected if (a) it is a CD4 T-cell master regulator, TCR/cytokine signalling node or chromatin co-regulator likely to be low-variance in resting cells, OR (b) it is a high-value readout immunologists interpret (checkpoints, cytokines), OR (c) it is a Tahoe-100M drug target with perturbation data in this dataset. Tier 1 additionally requires >=200 Rest-arm single-target cells (Andrea Sottoriva, Oct 2026: prioritise >=200 cells per perturbation). Genes with role node_only are protected as nodes but are not eligible as held-out regulators.
metadata.expression_gate: PENDING. Before the production SPORE run, compute the detection fraction of every listed gene in Rest-arm control cells (raw counts > 0). Genes detected in fewer than 1% of control cells are moved out of tiers 1-2 (to be reviewed) and removed from T3_tahoe_menu, giving v1.1. Perturbation is not proof of expression: the GSE314342 library targets all expressed genes PLUS all TFs, so non-expressed TFs and receptors (e.g. AR, ESR1, PGR, NTRK1-3) can appear perturbed.
metadata.notes: Gene symbols are HGNC. GSE314342 is 10x Flex (probe-based, 18,130 gene features); every gene must also be on the probe panel, which the expression gate checks implicitly. The 1-Jun and 2-Jun labels in the source guide names are JUN (Excel date damage) and must be merged to JUN in intake BEFORE the Phase 7 split, otherwise JUN guide-1 and guide-2 cells could land in different splits. The micro panels (400, 1,000) are completed with data-driven genes (strong held-out regulators, their top downstream DE targets, HVGs); this list is only their protected core. All three arms share the same biology, but the perturbation counts here are Rest-only; re-check counts before reusing the list for Stim8hr or Stim48hr.
metadata.source_dataset: Zhu R, Dann E, ... Pritchard JK, Marson A. Genome-scale perturb-seq in primary human CD4+ T cells. bioRxiv 2025.12.23.696273 (GEO GSE314342)
metadata.tahoe_source: Tahoe-100M selected perturbations (227-gene list, as in protected_genes_K562.json v2.0), used as a menu; 145 of 227 included

tcell_identity_tfs.rationale: CD4 T-cell identity and helper-lineage master TFs: the TCF7/LEF1/BCL11B/GATA3/RUNX/ETS1 core that holds T-cell identity, the IKZF family, TOX, the lineage-defining TFs of Th1 (TBX21), Th17 (RORC), Treg (FOXP3), Tfh (BCL6, MAF) and the CD4 lineage switch ZBTB7B (ThPOK), quiescence TFs KLF2/FOXO1/BACH2, and SATB1, ID2, ID3, PRDM1. Many are expressed at stable basal levels in resting cells and are routinely lost by variance-based HVG selection.

tcr_proximal.rationale: TCR/CD3 complex, CD28 co-stimulation and the proximal signalosome (LAT, LCP2/SLP-76, PLCG1, ITK, VAV1, PRKCQ, the CBM complex BCL10/MALT1, PTPRC/CD45, CD4). Constitutively expressed, low-variance in resting cells, and the entry point of every activation program. CD3 and CD28 knockdowns are also a built-in positive control because the screen re-stimulates through CD3/CD28 in the other arms.

activation_tfs.rationale: The three activation TF families downstream of the TCR (NFAT, NF-kB, AP-1) plus IRF4, the EGR/NR4A immediate-early TFs and MYC. In the Rest arm they sit at basal levels, which is exactly why HVG selection drops them, yet they wire the activation network. JUN is included under its real symbol: in GSE314342 its guides appear under the Excel-damaged labels 1-Jun and 2-Jun (513 + 114 single-label cells at >=3 UMI in Rest); intake MUST map both labels to JUN before the split.

cytokine_signaling.rationale: IL-2 and IL-7 receptor alpha chains and the JAK/STAT/CISH axis that keeps CD4 T cells alive and sets helper polarisation (STAT1/4 Th1, STAT6 Th2, STAT3 Th17/Tfh, STAT5A Treg). Only members with >=200 Rest single-target cells are here; the common-gamma-chain and JAK1/JAK3 knockdowns are near-lethal in IL-2-expanded cells (3 to 5 cells) and are kept as node-only genes in tier 2.

druggable_immunology.rationale: Tahoe-100M drug targets that are also core T-cell immunology drug targets: calcineurin (PPP3CA/PPP3CB) and FKBP12 (FKBP1A) for cyclosporine/tacrolimus/rapamycin, the glucocorticoid receptor NR3C1, cereblon and its IKZF3 neo-substrate (IMiDs), HDAC1/2, BCL2, MEK/ERK/p38, HSP90 and AHR. Placed in tier 1 so the smallest panels still carry druggable nodes.

helper_programs.rationale: Extended helper-subset, effector and stress TFs (EOMES, BHLHE40, HIF1A, NFIL3, IRF8, BATF3, ASCL2, TOX2, HOPX, IKZF4/Eos, NR4A2/3, EGR3, ZEB2, KLF6, ZNF683/Hobit, MYB, MXD4), TGF-beta SMADs and TGFBR2, and the ATF3/ATF4/XBP1 stress axis.

costim_checkpoint_markers.rationale: Co-stimulatory and checkpoint receptors (CTLA4, PDCD1, ICOS, CD27, TNFRSF4/9/18, CD40LG, LAG3, HAVCR2, TIGIT), activation and homing markers (CD69, CD5, CD6, CCR7, SELL, CXCR4, S1PR1) and the signature cytokines (IL2, IFNG, TNF, IL4, IL17A, IL21, GZMB). Mostly readouts of the network; protected because several are near-zero in resting cells and would never pass an HVG filter, yet they are the genes immunologists read.

tcr_downstream.rationale: TCR signal propagation and its brakes: RAS/MAPK (GRB2, SOS1, RASGRP1, KRAS, RAF1, MAPK3/8/9, MAP3K8), PI3K/AKT (PIK3CD, PIK3R1, AKT1, PTEN, INPP5D), DGKA/DGKZ, the negative regulators CBLB, PTPN22, PTPN2, PTPN6, CSK, UBASH3A, Roquin (RC3H1), Regnase-1 (ZC3H12A) and A20 (TNFAIP3), FYN, and the NF-kB kinase arm (TRAF6, IKBKB, NFKBIB). Several are autoimmunity GWAS genes.

chromatin_core.rationale: Chromatin regulators with defined CD4 T-cell roles: TET2 and DNMT3A (clonal haematopoiesis and T-cell differentiation), KMT2D and KDM6A, BAF (SMARCA4), BRD4, EP300/CREBBP, HDAC3, KAT2A, CHD4. Constitutively expressed and low-variance.

node_only.rationale: Central T-cell genes whose knockdown is poorly represented in the Rest arm (fewer than 200 single-target cells, often because the knockdown is lethal or slows growth in IL-2-expanded cells): LCK, ZAP70, CARD11, BATF, IL2RB, IL2RG, JAK1, JAK3, STAT5B, SOCS1, SOCS3, MTOR, EZH2, CTCF, ARID1A, PDPK1, MAP3K7, CHUK, IKBKG, DNMT1, SUZ12, RORA. Protected as graph NODES (targets) only: the micro-panel builder must not use them as held-out regulators for interventional scoring.

tahoe_menu.rationale: Remaining Tahoe-100M drug targets (the 227-gene menu) perturbed in the Rest arm with >=50 single-target cells (SPORE min_cells_per_perturbation) and not already listed above. Menu rule: 145 of the 227 Tahoe targets are in this file (across all categories); 69 have no perturbation data in GSE314342 and 13 have 1 to 49 cells, and these are not forced in. This category is subject to the expression gate in metadata before the production run.

quiescence_cell_cycle.rationale: Quiescence and G0/G1 control for resting T cells (CDKN1B/p27, CDKN1A, RB1, RBL2, E2F2, CCND2/3, TP53) and the anti-proliferative BTG1/BTG2/TOB1 module that actively holds naive and rested T cells in quiescence.

metabolism_survival.rationale: mTOR complexes and their regulators (RPTOR, RICTOR, TSC1/2, STK11/LKB1), glycolysis and lipid synthesis (LDHA, SLC2A1/GLUT1, SREBF2, PPARGC1B, MYCN) and the BCL2-family/FAS apoptosis machinery that sets activation-induced death.

chromatin_architecture.rationale: Cohesin loading/positioning and architectural TFs (RAD21, NIPBL, STAG1/2, YY1, MAZ). Constitutively expressed and almost always removed by HVG selection. CTCF itself is in node_only.

extended_chromatin.rationale: Extended Polycomb, Trithorax, COMPASS, BAF/PBAF, NuRD, BET, Mediator and H3K9 silencing machinery. Rescue only in the full 5,000-gene panel.
